steps.content: Once you step into the cockpit, a mechanical female voice rings out from the broadcasting system like an emotionless news anchor.

steps.speaker: V-710 Central System
steps.content: Friends from the MBCC, welcome aboard. This is the <color=#fb9259>V-710 Central Management System</color>. On behalf of Quinn, I would like to extend our warmest welcome.

steps.speaker: V-710 Central System
steps.content: Quinn has learned that for several months, the notorious desert bandits have been seriously destabilizing WhiteSands, which brought noticeable disruptions to DisCity.

steps.speaker: V-710 Central System
steps.content: In response, Quinn CEO Ms. Eirene established the WhiteSands Development Foundation to do everything possible to support WhiteSands on its path to prosperity.

steps.speaker: V-710 Central System
steps.content: Recently, we learned that the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control will participate in WhiteSands' counter-bandit operation. With the blessing of the Outland Affairs Bureau, we acquired the latest <color=#fb9259>Sand Ship V-710</color> for you to show our support.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Thank you for your support. We look forward to working with you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, how are you so calm? It's Quinn we're talking about! That super loaded corporation in Eastside! Their CEO Eirene is not only a ravishing beauty, but also a genius businesswoman!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Her corporation Quinn formed only eight years ago, yet managed to totally sideline all the old money in Eastside! Those old farts are so bitter that they launch smear campaigns against her in the media every day!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Too bad for them, because Quinn earned a solid reputation by splurging on Eastside charities every year, so not many people believe their slander. Alas, I love seeing those **** waste money and effort but end up getting defeated! It's my daily source of joy!
A low, cold grunt heralds the appearance of Chief Guillotin on the comms screen.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Chief, how unsurprising that someone under your command has been bought off by Quinn's cheap tricks.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You're the one who has been bought off.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yeah! Don't you love sheering their wool, too? You even got this great big ship!

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: What do you know, little brat! It's called reasonable access to commercial information!

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: The Outland Affairs Bureau has no qualms about Quinn's business expansion in Eastside. We are just concerned about the powerful forces behind the company.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: For a company to emerge from nowhere and grow so large in such a short time... no way am I believing that the Outlands aren't involved.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Everyone wants to bribe the Outland Affairs Bureau, Chief, even the FAC. They just need the opportunity.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: But I will not give Quinn this chance. They are propped up by dirty forces who I suspect are linked to the Outlands.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pfff... don't you love taking advantage of them, too? You even got them to buy you this great big ship!

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Hmph! Let me give you a word of advice... Never feel indebted to Quinn. They did what they're supposed to do. Don't forget your mission.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Also, the Ash Crystal in your possession will be placed in a special vault built by the Outland Affairs Bureau. Be careful... You cannot afford to bear the consequences of losing it.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Go meet the navigator of the V-710. He is the one who will truly support you.
Guillotin's comms avatar flickers for a few moments before disappearing. It seems that although the sand ship is a Quinn asset, it is completely under the control of the Outland Affairs Bureau.

steps.speaker: V-710 Central System
steps.content: The V-710's navigator, Mr. Kawa-kawa, is also an exceptional <color=#fb9259>WhiteSands explorer</color>.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I hear that WhiteSands explorers are extremely rare, often appearing in the most dangerous parts of the desert. They are the ones most familiar with this desert.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, we should go see him first.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Mmm... This smells so good! How can there be something so soft? And this... ahhh... so spicy! So satisfying!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: V-710! The food you prepared is so delicious! It's so much better than my usual meals of grilled scorpions and lizards!

steps.speaker: V-710 Central System
steps.content: Thank you for your praise, Mr. Kawa-kawa. There are also other dishes available on the V-710. Would you like to sample them, too?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: There's more?!! I... burp—hehehe, next time, next time... I'm full! I mustn't waste food!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This... this little kid is our navigator...?!
Hella stares at the burping boy in disbelief.

steps.speaker: V-710 Central System
steps.content: WhiteSands was once a forbidding no-man's land. Today's trade routes are forged by countless explorers who, despite the hardships and risks, chose to enter the sandstorm to collect data and chart the area.

steps.speaker: V-710 Central System
steps.content: As one of the explorers, Mr. Kawa-kawa is qualified to be the V-710's navigator.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I'm not that great. I owe everything to my predecessors. I simply cannot compare with them.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hello, Mr. Navigator. I'm the MBCC Chief, ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Cough cough! Chief?! Wow... So I'm navigating for such an important guy!
Kawa-kawa wipes his hands on himself before grabbing you.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: So, uh... if you face any problems, let me know. I'll do my best to help.
Hella looks at Kawa-kawa, who still has oil smeared across his lips. She edges close to you and whispers in your ear.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey... is this kid really up for the job? He gets nervous even around you! If we encounter desert bandits...
Boom boom! Boom boom boom! Boom!
Just as she finishes speaking, the V-710 veers sharply to the left. You hear a loud explosion from the starboard side of the ship.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's an attack.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, do you need us to...

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Ah no worries! This is a part of my plan for the V-710!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: The V-710 was originally a battleship, but we disguised it as a Hypercube freighter to lure in the desert bandits!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: When they bite the bait, I'll lead them to the quicksand trap in WhiteSands and wipe them out!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ptui ptui! There's sand and dust everywhere! I can't see a thing! Can you really run and hide at the same time?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Hehe, leave it to me! I know WhiteSands like the back of my hands!
Kawa-kawa goes to the bridge and turns the V-710 around to advance against the wind. The bridge's Hypercube force field deflects the billowing sand, opening up a safe combat zone for you in the rear.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Go on deck right now!
When you arrive on deck, you can clearly feel that the sandstorm has weakened.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: V-710, go around the sand dune ahead.

steps.speaker: V-710 Central System
steps.content: Command received. Reminder, this is an uncharted route, so unknown incidents are likely to occur. Please focus and respond carefully.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Don't worry, I take this route often! I can guarantee your safety!

The V-710 obeys Kawa-kawa's command and swerves behind the dune, which blocks the desert bandits' gunfire. The bandits' bullets stir up a haze of white sand, obscuring their vision and disrupting their flotilla formation.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, the desert bandits have changed their attack strategy. There are several guerrilla boats approaching.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmph! Let's show them what we've got! It's time for the V-710 to become a battleship again!
